bio.text: Randy Feenstra represents Iowa's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House and serves on the Ways and Means and Agriculture committees.
Before Congress he was Hull City Administrator, Sioux County Treasurer and chair of the Iowa Senate Ways and Means Committee.
He was born and raised in Hull, Iowa, and holds degrees from Dordt University, Iowa State University (master's in public administration) and Northcentral University (PhD).
